Your Tasks, on your phone.

Try the terminal in the open Simulator. Does continuing a Session feel comfortable enough to use away from your desk?

Current source: dbefca7f62. Built from mobile-ios.md, the iOS README and native Simulator captures. The live demo is an offline peer; nothing you type executes on a Machine.

1. Pick up existing work

Do: Open Session input study in Simulator, then choose Use keyboard.

Expect: View the existing terminal first; take keyboard control explicitly. Type a draft. Return submits; New line keeps writing.

Earlier native layout

2. Leave it unfinished

Do: Leave text at the prompt. Use the Sessions button to open another conversation, then return. Or go Home and reopen Loopflow.

Expect: The original draft remains. You return as a viewer; Use keyboard is a separate action. No input is replayed.

Find something without sending it

Do: Tap the magnifying glass and search for text in the terminal. Rotate the Simulator.

Expect: Search stays local. Done remains reachable. Landscape keeps the terminal above the keyboard.

3. Describe new work

Capture review: These are implemented native screens from layout tests. The open offline demo does not expose the New Task flow.

On a connected Machine, choose +, describe the work, pick a repository and choose Create & start. The keyboard microphone provides dictation. A lost reply can be recovered using the same saved request.
